notes: The 2 genuine critical (vertical-tangent) points at (+-1,0) ARE located, at essentially exact coordinates, but classified v_type=Singular (not Critical) because the augmented system [f,f_y]'s Jacobian is rank-deficient there (jacobian_rank=1, singular_values=[4,0]) -- an artifact of f_y=4y^3 vanishing to order 3 in y, NOT because the curve itself is singular (F_original gradient (4x^3,4y^3)=(4,0) at (1,0), full rank 1, geometrically smooth). Additionally, edge construction bypasses these 2 found points entirely: both edges' endpoints are 4 separate Artificial :endpoint_fallback vertices at (+-1,+-1), none of which lie on the curve at all (|f(1,1)|=1). Visual confirmation in renders/squircle_quartic.png: the render shows only 2 tiny disconnected arc fragments near the top and bottom (roughly the curve's corner regions near (+-0.85,+-0.85)-ish), NOT the full closed squircle boundary -- the 2 Singular markers at (+-1,0) are plotted as isolated points with no curve reaching them at all. The bulk of the curve (through (1,0), (-1,0), and the true top/bottom apexes near (0,+-1)) is missing from the render entirely, not merely mislabeled -- worse than the JSON vertex/residual summary alone suggested. See errors_log.md entry.
